posts.title: Organising a Conference, Slurping Coffee, Another Rabbit Hole
posts.description: WAZZZZZA , It feels like I wrote one of these aaages ago. October just kept going on and on and on . Packed month. We like that. Time has this funny ability to feel both fast and slow. Some months just evaporate before you realise it. Others feel long, dense, and full. October was like that, which is why CC is a bit late this time. But publish, we must! Birthday Surprises October is the girlfriend

posts.title: The Joy of Finiteness
posts.description: I’ve been thinking a lot about the joy of finiteness. I made this connection between joy and finiteness in the most peculiar way. I’ve been a YouTube enjoyer since the late 2000s. Back then, YouTube was simple. Search for videos. Click on one. Watch. Liked the video? Check out the channel that posted it. Like the channel? Subscribe to keep up with the channel’s new videos.
